Name: Nalo Farmer
Author: ZongWangxiaoyi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Replace the player farmer with Nalo — a civet girl from miHoYo's "Star Valley" — golden hair with mint inner strands, white muzzle and cheek fur, a leaf hair ornament, mint pinafore with a white shirt, black tights and green boots. Every farmer animation is covered: walking, running, tool use, fishing, eating and drinking, sitting, riding and swimming. Built at the game's native 16×32, 124 frames in three layers, 15-colour palette.

把主控角色整只换成「娜洛」——米哈游《星布谷地》里的麝猫少女：金色长发夹薄荷绿内发束、白色口鼻与颊毛、单片叶饰、薄荷绿围裙配白衬衫、黑裤袜与绿靴。覆盖全部主控动作：走路、跑步、使用工具、钓鱼、吃喝、坐长椅、骑乘、泳装。按原生 16×32 制作，124 帧分三层，15 色色卡。

This is an unofficial fan work made by a player. Nalo and "Star Valley" belong to miHoYo; this mod is not affiliated with, endorsed or licensed by miHoYo. It is free and non-commercial.
本 Mod 为玩家自制的非官方同人作品。「娜洛」与《星布谷地》版权归米哈游所有，与米哈游无隶属、授权或背书关系，完全免费、非商业。[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI 4.0 or later.
2. Install Content Patcher 2.0 or later.
3. Unzip and drop the NaluoFarmer folder into Stardew Valley/Mods/.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.

1. 安装 SMAPI 4.0+。
2. 安装 Content Patcher 2.0+。
3. 解压，把 NaluoFarmer 文件夹放进 Stardew Valley/Mods/。
4. 用 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• 124 drawn frames covering every farmer animation slot.
• Three separate layers; for downward-facing frames the hands are baked into the body layer, so tools are held in a visible hand.
• All 22 tool/weapon grip points and 6 back-facing sleeve boxes aligned to the game's offsets (max error 0.71 px).
• Config option HideClothes (default true) hides vanilla shirt / pants / hairstyle / accessory layers.
• No save-file changes — delete the folder to uninstall.

• 124 帧实绘，覆盖全部主控动作帧位。
• 三层分离；朝下方向的手烘进身体层，工具握在看得见的手上。
• 22 个握点、6 个背向袖段全部对齐游戏偏移（最大误差 0.71px）。
• 配置项 HideClothes（默认 true）隐藏原版上衣/裤子/发型/配饰层。
• 不改存档，删文件夹即卸载。[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• SMAPI 4.0 or later — https://smapi.io/
• Content Patcher 2.0 or later — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915

• SMAPI 4.0+ — https://smapi.io/
• Content Patcher 2.0+ — https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, and to the Stardew Valley Wiki Modding:Farmer sprite documentation for the frame map and layer references.

感谢 Pathoschild 的 SMAPI 与 Content Patcher，以及 Stardew Valley Wiki 的农夫精灵图文档。

[/color]
[heading][color=#D4D4D8]Known limitations[/color][/heading]
[color=#D4D4D8]• No dialogue portrait — the vanilla farmer has no portrait asset.
• Hats are drawn above the character, so a hat covers the ears completely (occlusion, not clipping).
• Fixed look: skin / eye / hair colour sliders have no effect.
• Conflicts with any other mod that replaces Characters/Farmer/*.

• 没有对话立绘 —— 原版主控没有肖像文件。
• 戴帽子会盖住耳朵：帽子层在角色之上，是遮挡不是穿模。
• 固定形象：捏人界面的肤色/瞳色/发色不生效。
• 与任何替换 Characters/Farmer/* 的 Mod 冲突。

Generative AI Disclosure: the character sprite artwork was created using generative AI tools under the author's direction. The author supplied the character references and specifications, and reviewed and corrected each revision (hand placement, silhouette, palette, head width and eye spacing) before integrating it into the mod.

Fan-work notice: Nalo and "Star Valley" (星布谷地) are properties of miHoYo. This mod is an unofficial, non-commercial fan work; it is not affiliated with, endorsed or licensed by miHoYo. No payment or donation is requested or accepted. Please do not use it commercially.

生成式 AI 使用声明：本 Mod 的角色精灵图使用生成式 AI 工具辅助制作，由作者主导方向；作者提供角色参考与规格，并对每一轮结果做审查与订正（握点、侧脸轮廓、配色、头宽与眼距）后整合进 Mod。

同人说明：「娜洛」与《星布谷地》版权归米哈游所有。本 Mod 为非官方、非商业同人作品，与米哈游无隶属、授权或背书关系；不收取费用、不接受打赏，请勿商用。[/color]
